Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)

A Militech classic, and a staple among their ranks. While not as advanced as their other models, the M-71 provides cranial protection at a low weight with a heap of extra equipment.

SP13 Head Armor with an Armor Penalty of -1 to REF, DEX, and MOVE. Has built-in Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors, Radio Communicator, and Smart Glasses. None of the built-in items can be removed.

Covers: Head
SP: 13
Armor Penalty: -1 to REF, DEX, and MOVE

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
